//: include is scoped to the sources we actually write. It used to be **/*.ts, which made TypeScript check the route type stubs that `next build` generates inside .next/ and .next-pnl/ too. Those stubs import their source route back, so a deleted or renamed route left an orphan behind that broke every future build. Next re-appends <distDir>/types to include on each build; the exclude list below neutralises it.
